Subject: Acme Corp — Pilot kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for a productive kickoff earlier today — appreciate you walking us through the fraud-detection workflow and the current pain points. Below is a short recap of what we heard, proposed pilot scope, success metrics, and immediate next steps. Please flag anything we missed.

Key pain points (as discussed)
- High false-positive rate from current heuristic rules (~18% FP) leading to unnecessary manual reviews.
- Latency spikes during peak traffic; can't run more complex scoring without jeopardizing SLAs.
- Hard to iterate on prompts and evaluate model regressions across historical cases.

Pilot goals / success metrics
- Reduce reviewer load by 25% (measured as decreased manual reviews per 1,000 transactions).
- Maintain or improve detection precision (target precision >= 88%).
- End-to-end inference p50 latency <= 120ms for the pilot traffic slice.

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks)
- Ingest: sample dataset (anonymized) of ~200k historical transactions (we'll provide S3 path).
- Models: evaluate two candidate open models (redwood/fast-13B and redwood/balanced-7B-quant).
- Eval: prompt set of 150 representative cases (see attached prompt_set_example.csv) with eval harness for precision/recall and latency tracking.
- Deployment: hosted Redwood sandbox project with dedicated capacity for the pilot; optional VPC peering if you prefer private routing.

Owners / responsibilities
- Acme: provide anonymized dataset + procurement kickoff (Sam / Priya).
- Redwood: provisioning, eval harness, prompt set onboarding (Marissa, Neha).
- SRE/Infra: Aditya to provision sandbox and set up metrics/dashboard access.

Timeline (tentative)
- Week 0 (this week): access + dataset transfer + initial prompt set upload.
- Week 1: model onboarding + first-run evals.
- Week 2: iteration on prompts + latency tuning.
- Week 3–4: wider validation and success-metric run.

Immediate next steps (action items)
1) Sam/Priya: share S3 path (or transfer instructions) and identify procurement contact (we can loop Anne if needed).
2) Acme: sign our standard POC MSA (I'll send DocuSign link after procurement confirmation).
3) Neha: will own prompt/eval setup and share the first prompt set by EOD Wednesday.
4) Aditya: will create the sandbox project and share console access + the access checklist.

Attachments: acme_poc_scope.pdf, prompt_set_example.csv

If this looks good I'll send calendar invites for the standing sync and upload the kickoff artifacts to the shared Drive link below.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
